K1_detection_B_digit.declared: extra non-empty on >= 0.95 of B AND D

K2_false_positive_A.declared: extra empty on >= 0.98 of A, i.e. FP <= 0.02

K3_coverage_A.declared: at least one value extracted on >= 0.30 of A

K4_coverage_digit_arms.declared: at least one value on >= 0.30 of A AND D and of B AND D

K5_coverage_A_value_answer.declared: AMENDMENT-1: at least one value on >= 0.30 of A AND N

flagged_items_on_B_digit.note: detection on real human value errors

arm_C_plausible_answer.note: submission is the question plus a human-written plausible answer drawn from another passage. `clear` here is a value present in this paragraph attached to the wrong subject: the pre-pass cannot see it and a judge must.

exposure_unsupported_inside_clear.note: share of genuinely unsupported items the pre-pass does not condemn, because it finds no absent value in them

false_positive_taxonomy_on_A.note: every arm-A item the pre-pass condemned, classified by whether the same numeric magnitude is in the reference under a different kind. `kind_mismatch` is the AMENDMENT-2 defect seen on real text; `absent_magnitude` is a magnitude the paragraph genuinely does not carry, which is a disagreement about the answer, not a defect.

clear.truth: value question settled; binding still open

resolved_without_an_expensive_check.note: condemn + clear. This is the judge budget the pre-pass removes, and a large clear share is the blind spot, not a win.
